description: ITS Directive Road Safety Information Data - Live Traffic Information from TransportNI is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport NI. The ITS Directive and UK traffic and lorry parking data - road safety related data from Transport Northern Ireland The UK Department for Transport and the devolved administrations are taking an opportunity offered by the European ITS Directive to improve access to open transport-related data and encourage its reuse. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Transport NI. It offers 6 resource(s) in XML. The portal shows 2017-02-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
